claim: Shadow of War runs on Monolith's Firebird engine, described as a LithTech-derived successor to the engine used in Shadow of Mordor.
evidence: PCGamingWiki lists engine 'Firebird Engine' (Eurogamer ref); Wikipedia LithTech says Firebird followed Mordor.
verification_method: Multiple independent secondary sources agree. Verify on our build by looking for LithTech-style strings (e.g. ClientShellDLL, ObjectDLL, LTAR) in a copy of ShadowOfWar.exe; projectconsole.cfg's 'GameClientShell.' prefix already fits LithTech naming.
limitations: Monolith's own studio page (lith.com) now redirects to warnerbrosgames.com, so the primary source is gone; internal architecture claims (client/server split) are unverified.
next_experiment: Static string scan of a copied exe for LithTech module/path names and any NetMesh/net-state strings to judge whether a latent client/server split exists.
